entities.summary: Sahar Khodayari, also known as the Blue Girl, was an Iranian football fan who immolated herself in Tehran to protest the national laws banning women from attending sports events and entering stadiums since the Islamic Revolution. She was a fan of Esteghlal F.C., and in March 2019, she attempted to gain entry at the male-only Azadi Stadium while disguised as a man to watch a match played by the team. On 2 September 2019, she was told by the Islamic Revolutionary Court that she may face a six-month prison sentence.
